business_summary: Chevron Corp is a US (NYSE: CVX) integrated energy major. It holds two distinct roles on the hormuz-maritime chain: Chevron Singapore is a listed top-10 bunker supplier at the world's largest bunkering hub, and its 50%-owned Tengiz field (TCO) adds non-Gulf barrels that reach market without transiting Hormuz at all.

exposure_summary.narrative: Chevron sits on two links: bunker-and-voyage-services (UNDISCOVERED) and non-gulf-energy-substitution (CROWDED, the Tengiz/TCO growth story is a well-covered narrative). FY2025 companyfacts gives revenue, growth, cash conversion and valuation cleanly, but companyfacts carries no operating_income_fy tag at all for this CIK and its cash/debt snapshots are over seven years apart, blocking margins, leverage and the reverse-DCF solve.
